findings.title: Validation error message leaks raw input
findings.body: The error message on line 8 includes the raw input `raw` which may contain sensitive data. Use the cleaned value `cleaned` in the message to avoid leaking potentially confidential information.

summary.problem: The new validation leaks raw input in an error message, risking exposure of sensitive data.
summary.done_well: The normalization logic now validates the presence of '@' before returning the cleaned address.
